fan_coastdown.description: Pedestal fan 1476 -> 0 rpm exponential coast-down over 20 s; 5 blades; stand rocking mode 14.2 Hz (zeta 0.02), head yaw 31 Hz (zeta 0.03). 1x crosses 14.2 Hz at 852 rpm.

pump_steady_misalignment.description: Pump skid at 1480 rpm with strong 2x (misalignment) in the axial (x) direction, 180 deg out of phase between motor and pump housings across the coupling.

pump_cavitation.description: Pump at 1480 rpm with suction-side cavitation: impulsive HF crackle in audio, raised broadband pipe/pump vibration (40-110 Hz) and vane-pass.

imbalance_before.description: Imbalance before: 1x amplitude factor 1.00 (after = 85% reduction of 1x).

imbalance_after.description: Imbalance after: 1x amplitude factor 0.15 (after = 85% reduction of 1x).

shake_test.description: Hand-held camera shake (1.5 px RMS, 0.3-6 Hz, + 0.15 px tremor 8-12 Hz) over a pump with only a small 1x (0.12 px) at 24.67 Hz; 60 fps. Tests shake cancellation using the wall.
